title: Deposition Transcript Attorney (CA Licensed - Remote)
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Depo Transcript Attorney to join our Workers' Compensation practice. This attorney will focus exclusively on the review of deposition transcripts in partnership with clients following each deposition - this role does not take or defend depositions. Instead, the attorney reviews the completed transcript and case file, discusses findings and next steps directly with the client, updates the file with any new information developed, and then moves on to the next deposition in the queue.
This is a high-volume, single-focus role ideal for an attorney who thrives on consistent process, clear client communication, and accurate timekeeping.
Key Responsibilities
Transcript & File Review

• Review deposition transcripts in detail upon completion of each deposition, identifying key testimony, discrepancies, and issues relevant to the case.

• Cross-reference transcript content against the existing case file, medical records, and prior discovery to ensure the file reflects the most current and accurate information.

• Update the case file promptly with any new facts, admissions, or developments uncovered during the deposition.

Client Discussion & Communication

• Conduct post-deposition discussions with clients to walk through the transcript, explain its significance, and answer questions.

• Communicate next steps and any impact on case strategy or value in clear, accessible terms.

• Serve as a consistent, reliable point of contact for clients during the post-deposition phase of their case.

Caseload & Time Management

• Move efficiently from one completed deposition to the next, maintaining a steady, high-volume review queue.

• Accurately track and enter billable time for all file review and client discussion activity in accordance with firm billing practices.

• Flag any cases requiring escalation to the assigned trial attorney or additional legal team members.

Required

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active member of the California State Bar, in good standing.

• Strong knowledge of California workers' compensation law and deposition procedure.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal information to clients in plain terms.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of files.

• Accurate and timely billing/time-entry habits.

Preferred

• Prior experience reviewing depositions or transcripts in a workers' compensation or civil litigation practice preferred but not required.

• Experience with client-facing case discussions.

• Familiarity with ALG internal case management and billing systems (or ability to learn quickly).

description:

The Analyst, Business and Competitive Intelligence is responsible for the identification, information gathering, planning and coordinating of sales based communication activities for a selection of designated accounts and contacts to effectively support business growth. Ultimately sourcing new sales opportunities for the Business Development team through inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting inclusive of Clinical Solutions, Labs and Biospecimens.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Periodically liaises directly with the Business Development team to identify specific companies of interest for continued nurtured outreach and meeting/RFP provision.

• Analyzes competitive environment to help make recommendations.

• Develops an annual outreach plan (reviewed monthly with LM and Business Development team) focused on securing new and repeat business from current and prospective biotech and pharmaceutical companies based on the analysis of:

• Social media (business news review, financial news, new lead identification, …)

• Competitive intelligence / business strategy (reviewing competitors website, conferences, communication/marketing activities)

• Decision makers and influencers within the identified company

• Undertakes research and analysis of Precision’s markets, competition, product mix, and specified product markets.

• Works closely with the Marketing teams to coordinate appropriate collateral provision to support the sales efforts of the company.

• Responsible for updating appropriate systems (Customer Relationship Management, Sales Enablement platforms etc) in a timely manner to ensure high standards of data integrity and for generating accurate weekly/monthly activity reports.

• Provides regular feedback to the LM, and Business Development leadership on the positioning of the company regarding pricing, competitiveness and market conditions.

• Bachelors degree in a marketing/communication/science or business related discipline/or equivalent experience in a marketing/communication/business development/sales environment.

• Possesses a keen understanding of the CRO and Specialty Labs market and the role that Precision plays in that environment.

• Minimum 6 months experience within the product/service sales lifecycle inclusive of client identification and prospecting.

• Direct B2B sales experience in service industry.

Other Required:

• Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel including overnight stays.

• Reads, writes, speaks fluently and comprehends the English language.

• Drive and determination to succeed as well as meet and exceed targets and quotas.

• Must be adaptable, professional and motivated and understand the sales cycle.

Preferred:

• Experience in either the CRO/pharmaceutical industry, or the life sciences industry.
Competencies:

• Exhibits high self-motivation, and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.

• Focuses on continuous improvement, including the ability to make proactive assessments on how to make processes more efficient and people more effective.

• Communicates both verbally and in written form in an exemplary manner.

• Conducts formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including scientific / sales / marketing teams.
